items.headline: Bruno Fernandes named Player of the Month for August
items.summary: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes wins the August award after an excellent end to the month.

items.headline: Mbeumo wins August's Goal of the Month
items.summary: Bryan Mbeumo's performance earns him August Goal of the Month award.

items.headline: Manchester United draw 2-2 at Everton in dramatic finish
items.summary: Ainsley Maitland-Niles scores in 90+5 minute to deny United victory. Carrick's side concede late despite leading.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes subject to Saudi Arabia and Turkey interest
items.summary: Intensifying interest from Saudi Arabia and Turkey in United captain. Club moving to trigger extension on current deal.
